title: rotang niger
intro: Rotang niger, commonly known as "Indian root," is a type of plant species that belongs to the Asclepiadaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its diverse health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, manage fever, and act as a natural remedy for various respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Rotang niger are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Rotang niger also include iridoid glycosides and asclepiadins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and potential uses in the treatment of various health conditions.
